text: Aurelia Air will open a hub at Castellane Airfield on 12 March, according to a company filing reviewed by The Continental Record and a notice from the Civil Aviation Authority of Valedon. The carrier said the base will support 18 daily departures in its first phase, with four A320neo aircraft positioned there by early summer and 240 jobs created over 18 months. In a statement signed by chief executive Maren Voss, the airline said Castellane’s central location would strengthen connections to inland cities and the coast. The airport’s director, Ivo Serrat, said the hub agreement was finalized after “months of operational review” and includes expanded gate access, maintenance support and a dedicated crew facility.
